```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(readr)
  library(stringr)
  library(janitor)
})

# -------------------------
# Input
# -------------------------
infile <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/Clinical_correlation/pILC_ClinicoPathological_details.csv"

# -------------------------
# Helpers
# -------------------------
trim_na <- function(x) {
  x <- str_squish(as.character(x))
  x[x %in% c("", "NA", "Na", "N/A", "na", "null", "NULL")] <- NA
  x
}

looks_numericish <- function(x) {
  # Accept numbers, decimals, percent signs, commas, <5, >5
  x <- trim_na(x)
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(FALSE)
  # if at least 70% match numeric-ish pattern, call it numeric-ish
  pat <- "^\\s*[<>]?\\s*[-+]?[0-9]{1,3}(?:,[0-9]{3})*(?:\\.[0-9]+)?\\s*%?\\s*$"
  mean(str_detect(x, pat)) >= 0.70
}

to_numeric_safe <- function(x, less_policy = c("as_number", "minus_epsilon")) {
  # Converts: "60", "60%", "<5", "  Negative   " etc
  less_policy <- match.arg(less_policy)
  x0 <- trim_na(x)
  if (all(is.na(x0))) return(rep(NA_real_, length(x0)))

  x1 <- str_replace_all(x0, ",", "")
  x1 <- str_replace_all(x1, "%", "")
  if (less_policy == "as_number") {
    x1 <- str_replace(x1, "^<\\s*", "")
    x1 <- str_replace(x1, "^>\\s*", "")
  } else {
    # <5 -> 4.9 ; >5 -> 5.1 (epsilon=0.1)
    x1 <- ifelse(str_detect(x1, "^<"),
                 as.character(as.numeric(str_replace(x1, "^<\\s*", "")) - 0.1),
                 x1)
    x1 <- ifelse(str_detect(x1, "^>"),
                 as.character(as.numeric(str_replace(x1, "^>\\s*", "")) + 0.1),
                 x1)
    x1 <- str_replace(x1, "^<\\s*", "")
    x1 <- str_replace(x1, "^>\\s*", "")
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x1))
}

top_levels <- function(x, n = 10) {
  x <- trim_na(x)
  x <- fct_explicit_na(factor(x), na_level = "Missing")
  tab <- sort(table(x), decreasing = TRUE)
  head(tab, n)
}

# -------------------------
# Read
# -------------------------
raw <- read_csv(infile, show_col_types = FALSE)

cat("\n============================\n")
cat("RAW COLUMN NAMES (as in CSV)\n")
cat("============================\n")
print(names(raw))

df <- raw %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), trim_na))

cat("\n============================\n")
cat("CLEANED COLUMN NAMES (after clean_names)\n")
cat("============================\n")
print(names(df))

cat("\n============================\n")
cat("GLIMPSE (types + preview)\n")
cat("============================\n")
print(glimpse(df))

cat("\n============================\n")
cat("FIRST 6 ROWS\n")
cat("============================\n")
print(head(df, 6))

# -------------------------
# Missingness report
# -------------------------
miss <- tibble(
  column = names(df),
  n_total = nrow(df),
  n_missing = map_int(df, ~ sum(is.na(.x))),
  pct_missing = round(100 * n_missing / n_total, 1)
) %>% arrange(desc(n_missing))

cat("\n============================\n")
cat("MISSINGNESS PER COLUMN\n")
cat("============================\n")
print(miss)

# -------------------------
# Per-column profiling
# -------------------------
cat("\n============================\n")
cat("COLUMN-BY-COLUMN PROFILE\n")
cat("============================\n")

for (cn in names(df)) {
  x <- df[[cn]]
  cat("\n----------------------------------\n")
  cat("COLUMN: ", cn, "\n", sep = "")
  cat("Class:  ", paste(class(x), collapse = ", "), "\n", sep = "")

  # Show a few raw examples (including weird ones)
  ex <- unique(trim_na(x))
  ex <- ex[!is.na(ex)]
  cat("Example values (up to 12): ",
      paste(head(ex, 12), collapse = " | "),
      "\n", sep = "")

  # Decide numeric-ish vs categorical
  if (looks_numericish(x)) {
    xn <- to_numeric_safe(x, less_policy = "as_number")
    cat("Detected as: NUMERIC-LIKE\n")
    cat("Numeric summary (na.rm=TRUE):\n")
    if (all(is.na(xn))) {
      cat("  (all values became NA after numeric conversion)\n")
    } else {
      cat("  min:   ", suppressWarnings(min(xn, na.rm = TRUE)), "\n", sep = "")
      cat("  q1:    ", suppressWarnings(quantile(xn, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)), "\n", sep = "")
      cat("  median:", suppressWarnings(median(xn, na.rm = TRUE)), "\n", sep = "")
      cat("  mean:  ", suppressWarnings(mean(xn, na.rm = TRUE)), "\n", sep = "")
      cat("  q3:    ", suppressWarnings(quantile(xn, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)), "\n", sep = "")
      cat("  max:   ", suppressWarnings(max(xn, na.rm = TRUE)), "\n", sep = "")
    }

    # Count how many have "<" or ">" patterns
    lt <- sum(str_detect(trim_na(x), "^<"), na.rm = TRUE)
    gt <- sum(str_detect(trim_na(x), "^>"), na.rm = TRUE)
    if (lt + gt > 0) {
      cat("Special values detected: ",
          ifelse(lt > 0, paste0(lt, " with '<'"), ""),
          ifelse(gt > 0, paste0("  ", gt, " with '>'"), ""),
          "\n", sep = "")
    }
  } else {
    cat("Detected as: CATEGORICAL / TEXT\n")
    cat("Top levels (up to 10):\n")
    print(top_levels(x, n = 10))
  }
}

cat("\n============================\n")
```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(readr)
  library(stringr)
  library(janitor)
  library(forcats)
  library(patchwork)
})

# -------------------------
# Input
# -------------------------
infile <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/Clinical_correlation/pILC_ClinicoPathological_details.csv"

# -------------------------
# Helpers
# -------------------------
trim_na <- function(x) {
  x <- str_squish(as.character(x))
  x[x %in% c("", "NA", "Na", "N/A", "na", "null", "NULL")] <- NA
  x
}

# Parse numeric-like values:
# - "60", "60%" -> 60
# - "<5" -> 4.9   (epsilon = 0.1)
# - "<10" -> 9.9
# - "5~10" -> 7.5 (midpoint)
# - "5-10" -> 7.5 (midpoint)
parse_numeric_mixed <- function(x, epsilon = 0.1) {
  x0 <- trim_na(x)
  y <- str_replace_all(x0, ",", "")
  y <- str_replace_all(y, "%", "")
  y <- str_squish(y)

  # range pattern: "5~10" or "5-10"
  is_range <- str_detect(y, "^\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?\\s*[~-]\\s*\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?$")
  is_range[is.na(is_range)] <- FALSE
  if (any(is_range)) {
    parts <- str_split(y[is_range], "\\s*[~-]\\s*")
    mid <- map_dbl(parts, ~ mean(as.numeric(.x)))
    y[is_range] <- as.character(mid)
  }

  # "<5" -> 4.9 ; "<10" -> 9.9
  is_lt <- str_detect(y, "^<\\s*\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?$")
  is_lt[is.na(is_lt)] <- FALSE
  if (any(is_lt)) {
    num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(str_replace(y[is_lt], "^<\\s*", "")))
    y[is_lt] <- as.character(num - epsilon)
  }

  # ">5" -> 5.1 (optional)
  is_gt <- str_detect(y, "^>\\s*\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?$")
  is_gt[is.na(is_gt)] <- FALSE
  if (any(is_gt)) {
    num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(str_replace(y[is_gt], "^>\\s*", "")))
    y[is_gt] <- as.character(num + epsilon)
  }

  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(y))
}

clean_status <- function(x) {
  x <- trim_na(x)
  case_when(
    is.na(x) ~ NA_character_,
    str_detect(str_to_lower(x), "pos") ~ "Positive",
    str_detect(str_to_lower(x), "neg") ~ "Negative",
    str_detect(str_to_lower(x), "unknown") ~ "Unknown",
    TRUE ~ x
  )
}

# -------------------------
# Read 
# -------------------------
df <- read_csv(infile, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), trim_na))

df2 <- df %>%
  transmute(
    sample = sample,

    age_dx = parse_numeric_mixed(age_at_diagnosis),
    tumor_cellularity = parse_numeric_mixed(tumor_cellularity_percent),
    pleomorphic_cellularity = parse_numeric_mixed(pleomorphic_invasive_compoent_cellularity_percent),
    tils = parse_numeric_mixed(ti_ls_percent),  # NOTE: your column is ti_ls_percent

    grade = trim_na(grade_differentiation_desc),
    her2  = clean_status(breast_her_2_neu_desc),
    er    = clean_status(tumor_marker_number_1_er),
    pr    = clean_status(tumor_marker_number_2_pr)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    grade = factor(grade),
    grade = fct_relevel(
      grade,
      intersect(
        c("Grade I", "Grade II", "Grade III", "Cell type not determined"),
        levels(grade)
      )
    ),
    her2 = factor(her2, levels = c("Negative", "Positive", "Unknown")),
    er   = factor(er,   levels = c("Positive", "Negative", "Unknown")),
    pr   = factor(pr,   levels = c("Positive", "Negative", "Unknown"))
  )

# -------------------------
# Long formats
# -------------------------
num_long <- df2 %>%
  select(sample, age_dx, tumor_cellularity, pleomorphic_cellularity, tils) %>%
  pivot_longer(-sample, names_to = "feature", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(
    feature = recode(feature,
      age_dx = "Age at diagnosis",
      tumor_cellularity = "Tumor cellularity (%)",
      pleomorphic_cellularity = "Pleomorphic component (%)",
      tils = "TILs (%)"
    ),
    feature = factor(feature, levels = c(
      "Tumor cellularity (%)", "TILs (%)", "Pleomorphic component (%)", "Age at diagnosis"
    ))
  )

# Build labels like "Feature\n(n=XX)" (non-NA values)
num_n <- num_long %>%
  group_by(feature) %>%
  summarise(n_available = sum(!is.na(value)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(feature_label = paste0(as.character(feature), "\n(n=", n_available, ")"))

num_label_map <- setNames(num_n$feature_label, as.character(num_n$feature))

cat_long <- df2 %>%
  select(sample, grade, her2, er, pr) %>%
  pivot_longer(-sample, names_to = "feature", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(
    feature = recode(feature,
      grade = "Grade",
      her2  = "HER2",
      er    = "ER",
      pr    = "PR"
    ),
    feature = factor(feature, levels = c("ER", "Grade", "HER2", "PR")),
    value = fct_na_value_to_level(factor(value), level = "Missing")
  )

# -------------------------
# Color palettes
# -------------------------
num_colors <- c(
  "Age at diagnosis" = "#1b9e77",
  "Tumor cellularity (%)" = "#7570b3",
  "Pleomorphic component (%)" = "#e7298a",
  "TILs (%)" = "#d95f02"
)

cat_colors <- c(
  "ER" = "#1f78b4",
  "PR" = "#33a02c",
  "HER2" = "#e31a1c",
  "Grade" = "#6a3d9a"
)

# -------------------------
# Theme
# -------------------------
theme_publication <- theme(
  panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

  axis.text  = element_text(color = "black", size = 11),
  axis.title = element_text(color = "black", size = 12),

  strip.text = element_text(color = "black", face = "bold", size = 12),
  strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black", linewidth = 0.6),

  panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8)
)

# -------------------------
# Numeric panel (boxplots + jitter)
# -------------------------
p_num <- ggplot(num_long, aes(x = feature, y = value, fill = feature, color = feature)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.45, linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0, alpha = 0.65, size = 1.6) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = num_label_map) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = num_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = num_colors) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  theme_publication +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL)

# -------------------------
# Categorical panel (bar plots + n labels)
# -------------------------
cat_counts <- cat_long %>%
  count(feature, value, name = "n")

ymax <- ceiling(max(cat_counts$n, na.rm = TRUE) / 10) * 10

p_cat <- ggplot(cat_counts, aes(x = value, y = n, fill = feature)) +
  geom_col(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0("n=", n)),
    vjust = -0.35, size = 3.4, color = "black", fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ feature, scales = "free_x", nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cat_colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, ymax, 10),
    limits = c(0, ymax + 3)
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1, color = "black")
  ) +
  theme_publication +
  labs(y = NULL, x = NULL)

# -------------------------
# Combine into Figure 1
# -------------------------
fig1 <- p_num / p_cat + plot_layout(heights = c(2.2, 1))

# Save outputs
ggsave("Figure1_pILC_CohortOverview_facets.png", fig1, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)
ggsave("Figure1_pILC_CohortOverview_facets.pdf", fig1, width = 12, height = 8)

fig1
```
